# edge (the system itself)

## Intent
A loop that moves knowledge toward "can act on it cold and explain why", that I keep
using after the novelty wears off, and that measurably reduces how often I reach for
AI before attempting. Done for v0 = four weeks of daily triage with no lapse longer
than two days, and at least one question that went inbox -> question -> schema -> cold.

## Predictions

| date | p | claim | outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-17 | 0.6 | I will stop doing daily triage within two weeks unless capture takes under 10 seconds | |
| 2026-10-17 | 0.7 | Most inbox lines in week one will be `?` and almost none `~` or `!` | |
| 2026-10-17 | 0.5 | The Socratic gate will feel slow enough that I will be tempted to bypass it within the first week | |
